history.summary: FLAG - UNCERTAIN IDENTITY AND TOWN: no web footprint exists for a 'Rampara Jogni Mata Temple', so this is a clearly-flagged placeholder. Rampara is a village near Wankaner in Morbi district (Rampara Wildlife Sanctuary area), NOT Rajkot - the CSV town has been corrected to Rampara (Wankaner, Morbi). Joganī Mātā is a well-known Gujarati folk/tantric goddess identified with Chinnamasta (see the Religions/MDPI study cited), and many Jogni Mata shrines exist across Gujarat, but none could be tied to Rampara. Coordinates are approximate (Wankaner city). Media is empty because no reliable image of this shrine was found.

town_description: Rampara is a village near Wankaner in Morbi district, Saurashtra, best known for the Rampara Wildlife Sanctuary. Wankaner is the nearest town, a former princely state capital with the Ranjit Vilas Palace.
